text:
samir: Heads up — postinstall hook in chart `payments-service` 2.1.0-beta failed during staging promotion in eu-west1. deploy-bot shows job crash with exit 137. Anyone on call?

deploy-bot: [auto] Promotion attempt #8421 -> status: FAILED
logs:
```
Hook job kubectl logs payments-service-migrate-xyz
panic: runtime: out of memory
exit status 137
```

adele: Ugh. Is this the new conditional migration we added to rotate tenant secrets?

kai: Right, the hook tries to migrate per-tenant config and we've seen memory blowup for large tenant sets. Staging was the first with >300 tenants.

marta: Confirmed - only staging and the first canary subset in prod-eu got the hook job. Other regions didn't run it yet because of rollout gating.

samir: Proposal: pin the chart for the staging namespace group to 2.0.8 while we hotfix the hook image and then re-promote. Pinning avoids rollback of unrelated services. Thoughts?

adele: I agree pin for affected namespaces. Alternative is annotating the release to skip hooks: `helm.sh/hook: post-install` skip isn't standard but we have our annotation `release.redwood.io/skip-postinstall=true` that deploy-bot honors. We could annotate existing release objects to skip re-run.

kai: If we pin, we should also ensure deploy-bot doesn't auto-promote those namespaces. We can add a deployment-exclude label instead: `release.redwood.io/exclude-from-promotion=true`. Which is less risky? Pin vs annotate?

marta: Annotating is faster (kubectl patch) and reversible. Pinning requires a chart rollback/pin operation which touches the release history. For staging I prefer annotation. For prod canary, maybe pin until hotfix validated.

samir: Ok actionable plan: 1) annotate staging namespaces with `skip-postinstall` and `exclude-from-promotion` to stop retries, 2) mark prod-eu canary namespaces as pinned to 2.0.8, 3) cut hotfix 2.1.1 with smaller hook image and memory limit, 4) run canary again.

adele: I'll run the annotations now. commands:
```
kubectl -n payments-staging annotate deploy payments-release release.redwood.io/skip-postinstall=true --overwrite
kubectl -n payments-staging annotate secret payments-config release.redwood.io/exclude-from-promotion=true --overwrite
```
I'm also sending a `deploy-bot promote --dry-run` after.

deploy-bot: [auto] Received annotation update for payments-staging. Promotion queue blocked for release payments-service:2.1.0-beta -> noting `exclude-from-promotion` flag.

oncall-bot: Reminder: update release notes and the changelog with the rollback/pin decision and mention tenants may see delayed rotation. Tagging @marta for release notes. :memo:

marta: I'll open PR for release notes and bump to 2.1.1 hotfix. Will include migration rollback steps and the `kubectl annotate` commands.

kai: Also capture decision in the release channel: pin vs rollback. We decided pin for prod canary + annotate for staging. Samir confirm?

samir: Confirmed. Pin prod-eu canary to 2.0.8 (manual pin via deploy-bot), annotate staging to skip hooks, create hotfix 2.1.1 with memory limit and retry/backoff. After hotfix validated, remove annotations and promote.

adele: Doing the pin now: `deploy-bot pin payments-service --version 2.0.8 --namespaces prod-eu-canary --reason "postinstall OOM, pin until hotfix"`

deploy-bot: [auto] Pin request queued. Preflight checks: chart 2.0.8 available -> OK. Pin applied to namespaces: prod-eu-canary. Promotion locks updated.

marta: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/payments/releases/PR-478 — includes release notes, migration rollback snippet, and checklist.

kai: Will we add a canary test to run the hook with smaller tenant subset before full promote?

samir: Yes — run hook locally against subset then apply to prod canary. If stable, unpin and remove annotations.

adele: I'll follow up with a quickpostmortem doc in release notes. Tagging ops for backup job in case we need manual rollback of tenant config.

marta: Copy. I'll also add a note to the changelog: "2.1.0-beta: postinstall migration caused OOM on large tenant sets; pinned to 2.0.8 for affected namespaces; hotfix 2.1.1 in progress."

samir: Thanks everyone. If anything changes ping here or escalate to oncall.

adele: Done: staging annotated, pin applied to prod-eu-canary. Will kick the hotfix build and post status. :rocket:
